nonvacuity: The two explicitly defined star families are genuine nonconstant finite laws, with 3072 equally likely microstates per block and all 16 binary outcomes having positive mass. Independent rational enumeration verifies both mean vectors, positive scaled variances 27/128 and 47/192, mean biases -3/128 and 1/32, and the exact lower expectation. Independent bounded blocks give Scaling and the probability limits. Forced edges saturate caps, and both regression designs have nonsingular Gram matrices. See scratch/exact_results.json and scratch/nonvacuity.md. Revision 2 changes the decision to refuted without changing the mathematics: the lower family satisfies Scaling and Valid, its feasible graph is unique, and the probability of a scaled variance deficit greater than 3/256 tends to one, contradicting the printed conservativeness claim. The old omissions remain fully disclosed, so the schema verdict remains correct_restricted.
